title: Expo recommendation photo layout verified in running app
summary: Mobile typecheck and lint passed; live product detail confirms full-width 3:4 recommendation panels. Remote photo visual validation remains incomplete.

changes.detail: Verified the change targets the Expo recommendation cards from the user screenshot. Previous website-only changes did not affect these cards.

validation.name: Live Expo browser layout
validation.detail: Opened local Expo on port 8081, navigated from home to Adidas product detail and scrolled to Vous aimerez aussi. Both target jacket photo buttons measured 232x308px at 520px viewport. Evidence: artifacts/expo-card-photo-size-20261025/live-metrics.json and live-related-520.png.

validation.detail: 919 reports valid before follow-up; all four history regression tests passed.
